description: This is a Python script for managing translation workflows in a FastAPI project, including translating pages, handling language paths, and automating GitHub PR creation.

methods.name: get_langs
methods.description: Cached function to load language names from a YAML file.

methods.name: generate_lang_path
methods.description: Generates the path for a translated language file based on the English source path.

methods.name: generate_en_path
methods.description: Generates the English source path from a translated language file path.

methods.name: translate_page
methods.description: Translates an English page into a specified language using an AI agent.

methods.name: iter_all_en_paths
methods.description: Iterates over all English markdown files in prioritized order.

methods.name: iter_en_paths_to_translate
methods.description: Filters English paths to those needing translation.

methods.name: list_llm_translatable
methods.description: Lists languages that can be translated via LLM based on presence of prompt files.

methods.name: llm_translatable_json
methods.description: Outputs JSON list of translatable languages, optionally filtered by a specific language.

methods.name: commands_json
methods.description: Outputs JSON list of available commands or a specific command.

methods.name: list_removable
methods.description: Lists markdown files in a language that are removable because their English source is missing.

methods.name: list_all_removable
methods.description: Lists all removable files across all languages.

methods.name: remove_removable
methods.description: Deletes all removable files for a specified language.

methods.name: remove_all_removable
methods.description: Deletes all removable files across all languages.

methods.name: list_missing
methods.description: Lists English files that are missing translations in a specified language.

methods.name: list_outdated
methods.description: Lists translated files that are outdated compared to the English source based on git commit times.

methods.name: update_outdated
methods.description: Re-translates outdated files to update translations.

methods.name: add_missing
methods.description: Translates and adds missing translations for files.

methods.name: update_and_add
methods.description: Performs both update of outdated and addition of missing translations.

methods.name: make_pr
methods.description: Creates a GitHub pull request with translation updates, handling branch creation and push.
